title: Count Valid Substrings I
statement: The task is to count the substrings of a string over 'a', 'b', 'c' (length up to 10^5) that do not contain "abc" as a contiguous substring. For each right end r, valid starts are exactly those after the start of the latest "abc" finishing at or before r, so one linear sliding-window scan adds r minus that start at every index.
